name: Coldhearted Precision (Ex)
body:
Prerequisites: Rogue or Ninja 4, Opportunities Aplenty class feature

Benefit(s): On attacks that would normally add opportunities aplenty damage on a successful hit, you add a competence bonus to hit equal to 1/4 your level.
